When I was sealed inside this chest, I silently vowed: Whoever frees me from this chest, I will grant their every wish! 
Now, fate is turning its wheel, and you're just one step away from setting me free: simply drop a few coins into the chest as a sign of goodwill!
But since this chest was left at the Nine Mortal Ways base, passersby thought it was a trick and never took that final step—such a shame! 
But I can tell—you're different. You are the master destiny has chosen for me! Let the coins ring out, and I'll appear in a flash to make all your wishes come true.
